visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The host, a young man with styled brown hair, stands in a professional studio environment. He wears a black pleated jacket over a dark shirt. He gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. The background is a dimly lit room with shelves containing blurred objects and studio equipment. (2) The scene shifts as the host now wears a beige fuzzy animal-themed hoodie. He holds a large white ergonomic pillow. Graphic diagrams of the pillow's butterfly structure and a cutaway shot of a physical therapist holding the pillow are shown to illustrate technical design. (3) Close-ups demonstrate the pillow's specialized material, specifically a visible mesh texture and thick foam layers being pressed by human hands to show elasticity. The host is then shown lying on the pillow atop a yellow sofa, demonstrating how it supports his head and neck during side-sleeping. (4) The host returns to a seated position while wearing the fluffy onesie, holding the white pillow toward the lens. High-contrast promotional text overlays appear at the center as he makes a four gesture with his fingers to emphasize the adjustable height options available.
